Replace Tray When Cracked. This NOTICE Battery Spill Tray sign from CGAP Safety reads: BATTERY SPILL TRAY / REPLACE TRAY WHEN / CRACKED OR STAINED / WIPE TRAY AFTER USE. Written for tire shops, parts counters, independent repair shops, fleet garages.

Why this sign matters

Keeps containment trays under stored batteries in working shape, so leaks stay contained and out of drains.

Where to post it

Mount on the rack front above the tray.

Who orders it

shop managers, lead technicians, parts managers.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards and practice to review for your site: Site practice. A sign supports your site procedures; it does not replace training or supervision.
